subject.title: Telegram: ForceReply prompt for the argument when an args-requiring command is tapped from the menu with no argument

question: Should missing free-text arguments become a shared native command prompt contract, a Telegram-only ForceReply behavior, or remain usage-text-only for now?
rationale: The request crosses shared command metadata, channel presentation semantics, and Telegram reply correlation; automation should not choose that product/API boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Shared prompt contract
options.body: Add a typed opt-in command prompt contract that Telegram can render as ForceReply while other channels can render their own supported prompt or usage fallback.

options.title: Telegram-local ForceReply first
options.body: Implement only in the Telegram plugin for selected commands, accepting possible drift from other native command surfaces.

options.title: Keep usage text
options.body: Decline the guided prompt for now and preserve the current command-menu tap followed by usage hint behavior.

recommendation.title: Shared prompt contract
recommendation.body: Add a typed opt-in command prompt contract that Telegram can render as ForceReply while other channels can render their own supported prompt or usage fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about shared plugin/channel command contracts and presentation boundaries, where the history points most strongly to steipete as a routing owner.
